summary_en: Hulic announced a tender offer to acquire all outstanding shares of Riso Kyoiku Group, its listed subsidiary operating cram schools and early childhood education services, to complete full consolidation. The transaction aims to accelerate decision-making, realize synergies with Riso Kyoiku and Tokyo Kyoiku Ken (operator of Tetsuryo-kai, acquired July 2026), and strengthen integrated group management of child education business across the spectrum from preschool to entrance exam preparation.
title_en: Supplementary Materials Regarding the Initiation of Tender Offer for Shares of Riso Kyoiku Group Co., Ltd.
translation_en_brief:
Hulic Co., Ltd., a real estate developer and operator, announced on October 13, 2026 that it has decided to conduct a tender offer for all outstanding shares of Riso Kyoiku Group Co., Ltd., a listed subsidiary in which Hulic holds a controlling stake. The tender offer is designed to complete the full acquisition and consolidation of Riso Kyoiku as a wholly owned subsidiary.

Riso Kyoiku operates a comprehensive education group including TOMAS (individual tutoring for entrance exam preparation), Shinbae-kai (early childhood education), and related services across cram schools, preschools, childcare facilities, and English conversation schools. Hulic has been a shareholder since September 2020 through a capital and business alliance; it consolidated Riso Kyoiku as a subsidiary in 2024 and has been expanding "Kodomodipart," a purpose-built education facility offering one-stop child services.

Hulic states that despite declining birth rates limiting student enrollment growth, per-child education spending is rising steadily due to government support expansion and increased dual-income households. The company aims to accelerate group-wide investment in high-value-added education services, strengthen integrated management to speed decision-making, and realize synergies. The acquisition is also prompted by market calls for unwinding parent-subsidiary listed structures. The transaction complements Hulic's July 2026 acquisition of Tokyo Kyoiku Ken (operator of Tetsuryo-kai, an elite university entrance prep academy), enabling the combined group to offer education services spanning from preschool through advanced university entrance preparation. Specific terms of the tender offer—including price, share count target, and timeline—are not disclosed in this release.
